preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 5 and 10,000 inclusive.
All characters in the input string s are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of distinct possible suffixes k matches the length of the suffixes list.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the suffixes list has a length of either 2 or 3.

postconditions.expression: all(suffixes[i] < suffixes[i+1] for i in range(len(suffixes)-1))
postconditions.description: The suffixes are printed in lexicographical order.
Each suffix in the suffixes list is a valid suffix of the input string s.
All suffixes in the suffixes list are distinct.
